sample_cases.desc: Verify user is able to sign in with valid credentials
sample_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the login page by using https://riverstream.azurewebsites.net/
2. Enter the valid Email.
3. Enter the valid password.
4. Click on the 'Sign in' button.
5. Verify successful login.
sample_cases.expected: User is successfully logged in, and the system should redirects the user to the dashboard.
sample_cases.actual: User is successfully logged in, and the system redirects the user to the dashboard as expected.

sample_cases.desc: Verify that an error message is displayed for an incorrect Email/password
sample_cases.steps:
1. Enter the invalid Email. 
2. Enter the invalid password. 
3. Click on the 'Sign in' button.
sample_cases.expected: User verify an error message should be displayed : "Email username or password".
sample_cases.actual: User verifies that an error message "Invalid Email or password" is displayed as expected.

sample_cases.desc: Verify login with empty Email and password fields
sample_cases.steps: Click on the 'Sign in' button.
sample_cases.expected:
User verify an error message should be displayed : "Email is required
Password is required".
sample_cases.actual:
User verifies that an error message "Email is required
Password is required". is displayed as expected.

sample_cases.desc: Verify Logout button visibility and location
sample_cases.steps:
1. Login to the application
2. Navigate to Dashboard
sample_cases.expected: Logout button should be visible at the bottom-left corner of the dashboard
sample_cases.actual: Logout button is visible at the top-right corner of the dashboard

sample_cases.desc: Verify Logout button functionality
sample_cases.steps: 1. Click on Logout button
sample_cases.expected: User should be logged out and redirected to the Login page
sample_cases.actual: User is getting logged out and redirected to the Login page

sample_cases.desc: Verify Organization dropdown is displayed
sample_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Dashboard page.
2. Observe the Organization field.
sample_cases.expected: Organization dropdown should be displayed with a default value.
sample_cases.actual: Organization dropdown is displayed successfully with the default value selected.

sample_cases.desc: Verify PO-ACK Recon Projects page loads successfully
sample_cases.steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
sample_cases.expected: PO-ACK Recon Projects page should load successfully with project list, search bar, and New Project button displayed.
sample_cases.actual: PO-ACK Recon Projects page loaded successfully with project list, search bar, and New Project button displayed as expected.

sample_cases.desc: Verify project list is displayed
sample_cases.steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
sample_cases.expected: List of available projects should be displayed with Project Name, Org Name, and Created Date columns.
sample_cases.actual: Project list was displayed successfully with Project Name, Org Name, and Created Date columns.

sample_cases.desc: Verify project details are displayed correctly
sample_cases.steps:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Review project records.
sample_cases.expected: Each project row should display the document list.
sample_cases.actual: Each project row displayed the associated document list correctly.

1. Navigate to Upload Document page
2. Click Choose File
3. Select a valid PDF file
sample_cases.expected: The system should accept the PDF file and upload it successfully
sample_cases.actual: The PDF file was accepted and uploaded successfully

sample_cases.desc: Verify user can upload a valid PDF file using drag and drop
sample_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Upload Document page
2. Drag and drop a valid PDF into upload area
sample_cases.expected: The system should upload the PDF file successfully
sample_cases.actual: The PDF file was uploaded successfully

sample_cases.desc: Verify user can upload a valid EDI file
sample_cases.steps:
1. Click Choose File
2. Select a valid EDI file
sample_cases.expected: The system should accept and process the EDI file
sample_cases.actual: The EDI file was accepted and processed successfully

sample_cases.desc: Verify Document Review page loads successfully
sample_cases.steps: 1. Open a processed document from the dashboard.
sample_cases.expected: Document Review page should load with PDF preview and extracted data.
sample_cases.actual: Document Review page loaded successfully with PDF preview and extracted data.

sample_cases.desc: Verify PDF document preview display
sample_cases.steps: 1. Open the Document Review page.
sample_cases.expected: Uploaded PDF should be displayed correctly in the preview panel.
sample_cases.actual: PDF document is displayed correctly in the preview panel.

sample_cases.desc: Verify page navigation and ciatation controls by clicking the Source number and the order line items value
sample_cases.steps: 1. Use the Previous/Next page controls.
sample_cases.expected: User should be able to navigation and citation between document pages.
sample_cases.actual: User is able to navigation and citaion between document pages successfully.

sample_cases.desc: Verify "Unknown User" reply for non-organization user
sample_cases.steps:
1. Send an email from an email address that is not associated with the organization.
2. Include a valid organization name in the email subject.
3. Process the email.
sample_cases.expected: System should send a reply email with the message "Unknown User".
sample_cases.actual: Reply email was received with the message "Unknown User".

sample_cases.desc: Verify direct estimation email processing when toggle is enabled
sample_cases.steps:
1. Enable the Direct Estimate Creation toggle in Organization Settings.
2. Send a SIF/PDF file through email.
sample_cases.expected: Email should be processed successfully and an estimate should be created.
sample_cases.actual: Email was processed successfully and an estimate was created.

sample_cases.desc: Verify direct estimation with draw file attachment
sample_cases.steps:
1. Enable the Direct Estimate Creation toggle.
2. Send a SIF/PDF file with a draw file attachment through email.
sample_cases.expected: System should process the files and generate an estimate successfully.
sample_cases.actual: Files were processed and the estimate was generated successfully.

sample_cases.desc: Verify "No Attachment" notification is sent when email is received without an attachment
sample_cases.steps:
1. Send an email without any attachment.
2. Check the response email.
sample_cases.expected: System should send a "No Attachment Found" notification email to the sender.
sample_cases.actual: Notification email received successfully.

sample_cases.desc: Verify successful extraction when a valid attachment is sent in reply to the "No Attachment" email
sample_cases.steps:
1. Send an email without attachment.
2. Receive "No Attachment" notification.
3. Reply with a valid attachment.
4. Verify processing status.
sample_cases.expected: File should be processed successfully and display Success status.
sample_cases.actual: File processed successfully with Success status.

sample_cases.desc: Verify email subject format when attachment is sent in reply
sample_cases.steps:
1. Send an email without attachment.
2. Receive notification.
3. Reply with attachment.
4. Check the subject of the processed email.
sample_cases.expected: Subject should contain only one Re: prefix (e.g., "Re: Lease Extraction Request").
sample_cases.actual: Subject displayed as Re: Re: Lease Extraction Request.
